insights.summary: No GLP-1 products (semaglutide, tirzepatide) stocked despite global market exceeding USD 50Bn. Anti-diabetic category flat at -0.2% YoY. Opportunity: 100 patients on GLP-1 = ₹1.2 Cr/yr incremental revenue.
WF generic share at 16.1% vs MedPlus benchmark of 22%. Each 1% shift from branded to generic adds ₹20-30L/yr in margin without revenue loss.
Average OOS rate 8.2% across stores but top-5 worst stores exceed 15%. Stockouts on top-20 SKUs alone cost an estimated ₹45L/month in lost sales. Reorder points need recalibration.
Online orders carry 3-4% lower margin than walk-in due to delivery costs and higher return rates (8.1% vs 3.2% in-store). However, online AOV is 12% higher.
